source.path: input/The Last Samurai - A Small Measure of Peace  Piano Tutorial.mp4

method.name: rendered-key-color-transcription
method.description: Read every video frame; map 88 keys A0–C8 across 52 white-key widths. Median HSV over a 3×3 key-center sample. White-key sample row 340, black-key row 298. Every contiguous blue or green key-down interval becomes a note; preserve one-frame release gaps and color changes. No audio-to-pitch model is used.

inspection.fallingBarCrosscheck: Width-filtered row-200 note-bar transitions were aligned with key onsets (modal delay: 18 frames). One apparent interior repeat at A4 around 309.67 s was inspected visually and was a continuous blue bar, so no split was introduced.
inspection.audioPitchSpots: FFT peaks at source 5.8, 6.8, 7.8 and 10.5 s corroborated the initial detected pitches D2/A2/D3, D4, A4, and C2/C4.
inspection.browserPlayback: Not verified; the in-app Browser is unavailable in this session.

limits: Timing is quantized to 30-fps video frames; this is not the original MIDI.
Velocity is assigned uniformly by part (left .65; right .8), not recovered from the recording.
Sustain pedal and performance dynamics were not inferred.
Final held notes end at the video fade-out detection boundary.
